purpose: Make the public trace lane operator-readable: absent bundle is blocked, rejected bundle is a hard stop, and accepted bundle is only allowed into selector evaluation, not promotion.
online_research_basis: HF generation docs: max_new_tokens/min_new_tokens, decoding strategy, cache_implementation, and GenerationConfig defaults are runtime variables.
HF generation utils docs: generate outputs can include sequences/scores/attentions/cache, so evaluation entry must be explicit.
PyTorch deterministic/timing docs: reproducibility and CUDA event timing require separate hardware/runtime claims.
